project.title: The Making of a Trio
project.analysis_scope: Harry, Ron, and Hermione friendship development
project.measurement_note: Relationship values are interpreted visual stages, not scientific measurements.

phases.label: Before Hogwarts
phases.summary: The three future friends have not formed relationships with one another.

evidence.excerpt: Invented demo evidence: Harry learns that a very different life and a new school await him.
evidence.relevance: Establishes the period before the trio meets.

limitations: Demo fixture uses invented placeholder evidence, not text from the novel.

phases.label: New Classmates
phases.summary: Harry and Ron begin to connect, while Hermione remains at the edge of their new friendship.
phases.change_from_previous_phase: The characters meet and begin forming first impressions.

character_actions.action: Shares the uncertainty of starting school.

character_actions.relationship_effect: Makes herself known, though not yet close.

cooperation: Harry and Ron navigate their first school experiences together.
conflict: Ron and Hermione form impatient first impressions of one another.

harry_hermione.label: Aware of one another
harry_hermione.reason: They know one another but are not close.

evidence.excerpt: Invented demo evidence: two nervous new students talk, share snacks, and find easy companionship.
evidence.relevance: Shows the first strong pair connection.

limitations: Demo fixture uses invented placeholder evidence, not text from the novel.

phases.label: Early Tension
phases.summary: The three interact more often, but differences in temperament create friction.
phases.change_from_previous_phase: Awareness becomes direct interaction, without equal trust among all three.

character_actions.relationship_effect: Keeps her socially separate from the boys.

conflict: Different attitudes toward school and rules lead to hurt feelings.

ron_hermione.label: Interacting
ron_hermione.reason: Frequent interaction is marked by tension.

evidence.excerpt: Invented demo evidence: a careless remark exposes the distance between two classmates.
evidence.relevance: Represents the phase's central interpersonal tension.

limitations: Demo fixture uses invented placeholder evidence, not text from the novel.

phases.label: The Troll
phases.summary: Shared danger pushes the three classmates to act for one another and changes the shape of the group.
phases.change_from_previous_phase: Risk and mutual help replace distance with emerging trust.

character_actions.action: Protects the boys after the danger passes.

cooperation: The three respond to a dangerous situation with complementary actions.

harry_hermione.label: Developing trust
harry_hermione.reason: Mutual help creates a new bond.

evidence.excerpt: Invented demo evidence: in a moment of danger, each student does something that helps the others.
evidence.relevance: Supports the transition from classmates to friends.

limitations: Demo fixture uses invented placeholder evidence, not text from the novel.

phases.label: Working as a Team
phases.summary: The friends combine different strengths while investigating problems and confronting increasingly difficult challenges.
phases.change_from_previous_phase: A friendship born in one crisis becomes sustained teamwork.

character_actions.action: Takes initiative when the stakes rise.

character_actions.relationship_effect: Makes a decisive contribution to the team.
Helps the group move forward safely.

cooperation: The trio shares information, plans together, and divides challenges according to individual strengths.
conflict: Concern and disagreement remain, but no longer define the relationships.

harry_ron.label: Strong team
harry_ron.reason: Friendship and teamwork reinforce one another.

harry_hermione.label: Established friendship
harry_hermione.reason: They trust each other's judgment and loyalty.

ron_hermione.label: Established friendship
ron_hermione.reason: Their contrasting strengths now support the group.

evidence.excerpt: Invented demo evidence: the trio faces a sequence of obstacles by relying on a different person's strength each time.
evidence.relevance: Demonstrates mature teamwork across the trio.

limitations: Demo fixture uses invented placeholder evidence, not text from the novel.
